### **_Better Frames Per Second!_**

**Better Frames Per Second!** is a pure **optimization** modpack built to make Minecraft run **smoother**, **faster**, and more **stable**.

It includes carefully selected **performance-enhancing mods** that:

**Increase FPS**

**Reduce lag spikes**

**Improve chunk loading**

**Optimize memory usage**

**Enhance rendering efficiency**

No **content changes**. No **gameplay alterations**. Just better **_performance_**.
